title: Vow and Tide
author: Freya Ishikawa
blurb: Sebastian Oyelaran, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
